value: **Involvement**: Teachers actively participated in collaborative co-design workshops, design meetings, or teacher communities with researchers to iteratively develop, test, and adapt curriculum units, assessments, and lesson plans. **Evidence**: "By engaging Teachers of Students with Visual Impairments (TVIs) as co-design informants, we seek to connect theoretical principles of multimodal and inclusive learning with the pragmatic realities of STEM teaching for BLV learners (Hutchins & Biswas, 2024)."
